contexts.text: Aaron's rod swallowed their rods () = that power was taken away from them.

In the other life there appear two statues... which swallow those who think about what the Divine was doing from eternity... The swallowing represents that man is not able to extricate himself from thinking from space and time... TCR 31:end. SE 3481.
Strangers who swallow () = falsities from evil which consume.
The earth swallowed the flood that the dragon cast out of his mouth (). To swallow = to cause to come to nothing. AE 764.
Where they are swallowed as by wolves.
In a certain Hell under the feet, they were lamenting because by phantasies they were swallowing them, and casting them up...
They were then all swallowed up in a gulf.
The mountain opened and swallowed them.
The dispersion of all truth, and the consequent destruction of all good, is signified by, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me as a whale... ().
